@deskInvNav.description: Sidebar entry for invoices: to pay and issued. One word.

@deskInvTitle.description: Title of the Invoices page: invoices to pay (tab Pay) and invoices this wallet issued (tab Issue).

@deskInvTabPay.description: Tab on the Invoices page: invoices sent to this wallet, waiting for an answer. A short verb.

@deskInvTabIssue.description: Tab on the Invoices page: invoices this wallet issued to others. A short verb.

@deskInvTabCount.description: A tab label with how many items in it need you, e.g. 'To pay (2)'.

@deskInvIssueAction.description: Button: start a new invoice to someone who should pay this wallet.

@deskInvChecking.description: Status while the wallet asks the relay for invoices and payments.

@deskInvCheckedAt.description: When the wallet last asked the relay for invoices, e.g. 'Checked at 14:32'.

deskInvCheckFailedTitle: The Epicbox server is not answering

@deskInvCheckFailedTitle.description: Notice title when checking for invoices failed.

deskInvCheckFailedBody: The lists show what arrived before. Nothing was lost; the wallet tries again every 2 minutes.

@deskInvCheckFailedBody.description: Notice text when checking for invoices failed.

@deskInvReqWaiting.description: State of a request you sent: delivered, no answer yet.

@deskInvReqPaid.description: State of a request you sent: the payer paid, your wallet finishes and posts the payment.

@deskInvReqPosted.description: State of a request you sent: the payment is posted to the network, not yet in a block.

@deskInvConfirming.description: State: the payment is in blocks, e.g. 'Confirming 2 of 3'.

@deskInvCompleted.description: State: the payment has enough confirmations.

@deskInvReqNotPosted.description: State of a request you sent: paid and finished, but the node refused it or could not be reached.

@deskInvDeclined.description: State: the invoice or request was declined.

@deskInvExpired.description: State: time ran out before an answer.

@deskInvWithdrawn.description: State: the request was withdrawn by the one who sent it.

@deskInvReqBounced.description: State of a request you sent: the payer's wallet cannot pay requests and returned it.

@deskInvPayWaiting.description: State of an invoice you received: waiting for your answer.

@deskInvPayPaying.description: State of an invoice you approved: signing and sending the payment.

@deskInvPayNotDelivered.description: State of an invoice you paid: the signed payment did not reach the relay; funds stay locked until Retry or Cancel.

@deskInvPayDelivered.description: State of an invoice you paid: the service has your payment and must post it.

@deskInvPayPosted.description: State of an invoice you paid: the service reports it posted the payment.

@deskInvPayWithdrawnAfterPay.description: State of an invoice you paid: the service withdrew it afterwards; you may cancel the payment.

@deskInvPayPastTtl.description: State of an invoice you paid: its time passed and the payment is not in the pool or on the chain; you may cancel it.

@deskInvPayCancelled.description: State of an invoice you paid: you cancelled the payment; the funds are back.

@deskInvUnpaid.description: Word beside the amount of an invoice this wallet issued that is not paid: it is not money received.

@deskInvYouPay.description: Word beside the amount of an invoice you received: money that would leave your wallet.

@deskInvExpiresAt.description: Absolute expiry time, e.g. 'Expires 22 Oct, 14:30'. Shown on hover of a countdown.

@deskInvAdvanced.description: Title of a fold that holds technical controls (slate ID, rotation, expiry). Desktop has no Advanced switch.

deskInvOneDevice: Use invoices on one device only. Another device with this wallet can take a payment meant for this one.

@deskInvOneDevice.description: Standing warning on the request form, Review and Settings › Invoices: the same wallet on two devices can intercept invoice payments.

deskInvFailed: That did not work. Nothing changed; try again.

@deskInvFailed.description: Error notice when an invoice action failed for a reason without its own words.

@deskInvHowItWorks.description: Link on the Invoices page to Help › Invoices.

@deskInvAddressHint.description: Hint in an Epicbox address field: the shape of an address. Keep as is.

@deskInvEpicboxAddress.description: Title of the QR of this wallet's Epicbox address (its payments address).

@deskInvPayStalled.description: State of an invoice you paid: the payment has not reached the network a while after paying, though the wallet sent it again by itself.
